'''Irlyn Resk''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He was the first [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] to lead the [[Dark Riders]], a group of [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] mounted [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commandos]] that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Stend VI]] to combat [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gangs]].

==Biography==
Irlyn Resk was a famous [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] [[Imperial Scouts|scout]] who was chosen to lead a new elite unit of [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commandos]] called the [[Dark Riders]]. The [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gangs]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Stend VI]] had overwhelmed the local authorities and [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] reinforcements, including a [[Hoversled/Legends|repulsorlift sled]] [[Fighter wing/Legends|wing]] but they were also overwhelmed by the sheer number of swoop gangs that had taken over the planet. The main problem was that the gang swoops were too fast and the riders too skilled for regular troops and authorities so an elite unit was created to remedy that problem. Resk was a natural choice to be the units first commander and although he was a loyal officer he had a hidden agenda. He wanted [[Blizz Pinnix]]'s prize swoop, the ''[[Black Raptor]]'' and would have done anything to link Pinnix to one of the swoop gangs so he could confiscate the prized vehicle.<ref name="WHSV" />

==Personality and traits==
Resk was a typical [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] officer which meant that he was cruel, bigoted, and believed in the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] above all else. He was honored to be selected as the elite units first leader and was driven to be successful with his command. His desire to serve was not immune to greed, however, and he was willing to use the Empire to further his own agenda which involved the famous ''Black Raptor'' swoop bike.<ref name="WHSV" />

==Skills and abilities==
Like all Army officers, Lieutenant Resk was well trained in combat however he was only well trained in a very specific set of skills, namely [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and mounted weaponry. He had commando and scout training as well however again outside of the specific skills necessary to sneak around undetected or keep his equipment in order he was lacking. He was very skilled at piloting a swoop or speeder bike and had the talent and equipment to keep up with almost every swoop rider on the planet.<ref name="WHSV" />

==Equipment==
The Empire spared no expense when outfitting this elite unit. Resk was outfitted with [[Storm Commando armor/Legends|Storm Commando armor]], a [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbine]], a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], a [[Survival kit/Legends|survival kit]] and a standard [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belt]]. He rode a modified [[Ikas-Adno/Legends|Ikas-Adno]] [[XR-10 Shadowhawk]] which was nearly 100 [[Kilometer per hour/Legends|kph]] faster than almost any other swoop gang's vehicle.<ref name="WHSV" />

==Behind the scenes==
Irlyn Resk was designed by [[Paul Danner]] and [[Bill Smith]] for ''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]'', a supplement for the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' that was published by [[West End Games]] in [[1997]]. He was illustrated by [[Greg Smith (illustrator)|Greg Smith]].
